reviews.text: Great experience! My dog had been sick all night and my vet didn't have any availability. Was able to get in right away. Dr. Westphal was terrific, explained in detail issues and next steps. Would highly recommend and will be switching vets.
We are new to this practice but very much like our vet. She takes time to explain and listen. Very caring!

I found two lost dogs and popped into the clinic. They checked them for chips and also clean them up since they clearly had been running around in the desert. They were super helpful on short notice and clearly care about animals

There are some people you meet during the hardest moments with your animals who you will never forget. Dr. Westphal and the team at Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic are those people for me.

After six years of living in Arizona and being disappointed time and time again by large, corporate-owned veterinary hospitals, I finally found a veterinarian who I genuinely trust with my animals.

What Dr. Westphal has done for Asher—and for us while trying to navigate everything happening with him—has meant more than I can adequately put into words. She has been compassionate, thorough, incredibly attentive, and, most importantly, honest with me. She communicates directly, explains what she is seeing and thinking, and approaches his care like a veterinarian who is truly practicing medicine rather than simply moving a patient through a system.

When you love your animals as deeply as we do, that matters enormously.

And it isn’t only Dr. Westphal. Her entire staff reflects that same kindness and compassion. From the way they speak to you, to the way they handle your animal, to the support they give you when you’re scared or overwhelmed—you can feel that they genuinely care. The fact that an entire team operates this way tells you that Sonoran Foothills is a very special place.

When your dog is sick, you need more than someone with a veterinary degree. You need someone you can trust to tell you the truth, help you make the right decisions, and care about the animal standing in front of them.

I finally feel like I have that.

I am incredibly grateful for Dr. Westphal and every person at Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic. Thank you for caring for Asher, for supporting us through this, and for reminding me what compassionate, honest veterinary medicine is supposed to feel like.

You have earned my trust, and that is something I don’t give lightly.

I can honestly say that I’ve never met a group of people who care so much about a strangers pet. I grew up in a small town with a single vet that everyone knew, he was always transparent and cared deeply about the animals he treated. Living in a time where those types of clinics don’t typically exist anymore, Sonoran and their team made my wife and I feel like we time traveled back to when vet clinics truly cared about the animals and not the cash grab. We’ll be bringing Tater in after his recovery so he can show you his true energetic self. Thank you all.

Thank you Dr. Westphal at Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic! You've been our go to vet for a number of years now. The compassion of you and your staff at our tragic time of loss is overwhelming! Thank you for your love and support doing our difficult time losing Tiffany.

Have lived in the area for 15+ years and needed a vet.  My normal vet seems to be too busy to see me - let alone answer the phone when I call - so I tried Sonoran Foothills today.  I called.... THEY ANSWERED!  I said I need help.  They said "We can see your dog this afternoon - how would that be?"

The appointment was great - the Doctor took great care of my dog, answered all my questions, made sure I understood any concerns, helped me with the required meds and treatment.

Would HIGHLY recommend if you're looking for a great neighborhood vet!
Solve my dogs problem in the first visit after leaving D.M. veterinary for over ten year's that could not find the problem.

I recently had to find a new pet clinic after my longtime vet stopped performing surgeries, and I’m so glad I found this one. My dog, Murphee, was spayed here and the experience was excellent from start to finish.

The entire staff was kind, professional, and took the time to answer all my questions, which made me feel completely at ease. Everything went smoothly, and I really appreciated the clear communication and follow-up.

Switching vets isn’t easy, but I feel confident knowing Murphee is in great hands. I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate and reliable care.

Spectacular clinic! Dr. Westphal and Stephanie made sure my cat, Clover, was comfortable the entire visit. The office was well-kept and the team was very transparent about costs, so we did not end up with unexpected fees. Stephanie spent time loving on Clover and making sure she was happy the entire time (even gave her a treat during the vaccination!). It is clear that they care deeply about the animals that come in, and are very skilled at what they do. I would highly recommend Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic!

Our dog required surgery, and Dr. Starkel and the team at Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic were amazing.

Their professionalism, kindness, and clear communication made the entire process smooth and reassuring. The care our dog received was truly above and beyond.

Highly recommend!

My soon to be 13yr old Rottweiler/German Shepard is in great hands. I live all the way out in Glendale, its definitely worth the drive. I dont trust my baby's care with just anyone. I feel heard when I have concerns and I feel like my dogs needs are most definitely met. The care here most definitely exceeds my expectations. Along with staff, their excellent. I would give more stars if allowed. Most definitely recommend.
Highly recommend Dr Westphal and her entire staff.  Good people that care about you and your pet!
They always take great care of our pooches! Very well priced and easy to get an appointment.
Was looking for compassionate, low pressure care for our aging (dog) baby and we finally found them! Can't recommend this group enough!
Highly recommend this clinic to all pet parents. Clinic is very  nice and clean and affordable. All the staff is very friendly. Dr Westphal is the BEST!! She's very gentle caring and understanding.

Quick appointments. Close to home. Friendly staff that actually seems to like the animals. I recommend you buy any products/ meds/ supplements elsewhere for better selection and prices, but the visit and procedure prices seem on par with other vets.
Thank you so much!

Thank you for providing compassionate care when I had to say good bye to my precious dog. The experience of having to say good bye is never going to be easy, but you made it better by being so caring and kind. Thank you. I also thank you for continuing to care for our other dogs, who we consider to be our children. We wouldn't trust just anyone with our dogs, but we trust you.

Dr. Westphal and her staff are absolutely amazing. I was very nervous about my geriatric cat, Emma, needing a dental, and I wasn't able to pay for the $5000 board certified dental that Dr. Westphal recommended. She agreed to do the dental as long as I understood the risks. From the beginning, Dr. Westphal and her staff showed the utmost care and concern for Emma, doing what they could to minimize the risk of the procedure. She was even gracious enough to let me have input on Emma's care, including approving at home sub-cutaneous fluids before and after the procedure to help support Emma's kidneys. The doctor who performed the dental (I forgot her name) was so nice and showed great care and concern for Emma as well. Emma did great during the dental and the cost ended up being hundreds of dollars less than what I thought it would be, even with multiple extractions. I am so excited to have such a wonderful veterinarian for my pets. Thank you, Dr. Westphal and staff!

We’re so grateful that you trust us with Bella’s care! This means the world to us. Thank you so much for your review!  
Warm wishes,  
Dr. Westphal and the Team  
Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic

The staff was very friendly and courteous, they took care of our baby with the utmost care. They were empathetic, kind and also did not charge extraordinary fees like most Vets. We will be using them in the future to bring out cat Chi-Chi to.

Thank you so much, Dora, for your wonderful 5-star review. We genuinely appreciate your support and value you as a cherished part of our community! 
Dr. Westphal and Staff

While the doctor and tech showed great care with my cat, the management of treatment was not on par. We went for 1) an annual exam; 2) vaccinations; 3) nail trim; 4) ear cleaning. After an examination declared healthy, they took my cat to the back for the other procedures. Instead of most to least important in order above, they started with the ear cleaning. According to their description afterwards, my cat was uncooperative for the other procedures and brought back to me in her carrier. I had provided suggestions based on previous vet visits (she's 12 y/o and never had this problem!) Now, I get to miss work again to go back again multiple times - and they suggested drugs. I appreciate they were concerned with her anxiety but in my opinion, these are dog people and perhaps aren't as skilled with handling cats.
WOW!! What an amazing team! Best vet ever! Our first time there with our fur babies and we will be life long patients!
Nice, friendly, helpful staff.
I always feel like Mabel gets the best treatment at Sonoran! Quick, friendly and super clean! Thanks Dr. W and staff!
Cool caring people
Really great with cats!

Dr Westphal is AMAZING! She takes her time to explain things, provides options, and cares about our pets overall health. Her team is great with communication, scheduling, and answering questions. Thank you from Autumn & Summer

I have been taking my Frenchie, Bruce, here since we moved to the area a few years back. He had developed allergies due to the climate change from FL to AZ and has been getting successful and mindful treatment from Dr Westphal. Dr Westphal is the most caring and patient vet I have met in a while. Her approach to care is focused on actually treating, and not over testing and price gouging. She is truly wonderful along with the entire staff at the clinic! Thank you, Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic!
Thank you, Gary, for the 5-star review. We are glad to have been able to accommodate you during your difficult time. Hannah was such a sweet companion. - The Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic Team
I love Sonoran Foothills Pet Clinic, they always take amazing care of my Biscuit girl!!
Dr. Westphal & her staff are always so kind & explain everything in detail. They go above & beyond.
1st time there with my puppy.  They were professional and knowledgeable.  Great prices and good info provided…. Thank You!
Was very pleased with staff and Dr. Westphal.. Appreciate their care, kindness and educating us about our dogs and their health!

Dr Westphal is a one of a kind veterinarian in the valley that is hard to find.  She deserves more than 5 stars.
She loves and cares your fary child.  She spends time and listens to your pets …
Best clinic we have found. Dr. Westphal always gives us professional, caring, and friendly service.  We trust her judgement completely.  We wouldn't go anywhere else! 🐶 …

My Cat Boo Kitty. Loves the doctors and their team. Great front office.
